segments.summary: Reviewed worktree event, command, file-manager, working-directory, path-display, and LSP contracts exactly and adversarially; found missing command-state and LSP-race detail.

Reviewed remote authority, provider degradation, lifecycle errors, acceptance coverage, and MVP exclusions; exact authority boundaries are strong, while error mapping and identifier-only oracles leave gaps.
Reviewed chat actor, route, blocked-notice, identity, recovery, package/seam/lane, and permission boundaries; the source makes delegation, immutability, and approval isolation explicit.

Reviewed worker memory, history performance, navigation, route determinism, ownership, extensibility, and stale references; missing storage bindings, performance budgets, and payload serialization remain adversarial gaps.
Reviewed extract-token normalization and visible Goal controls, tracker, blockers, evidence, and completion; goal projections are strong, but token-to-role mapping remains incomplete.

Reviewed child-goal presentation, chat/runtime ownership, Planning Wizard handoff, discovery visibility, and file mentions; privacy-safe discovery is explicit while structured-seed operational bounds are missing.

Reviewed vision-bridge and Teach/Teacher contracts across disclosure, permissions, source handling, GUI actions, memory, and handoffs; both need more explicit durable permission or capture state machines.

Reviewed visualizer streaming, notification trust, DRY disclosure, onboarding Teacher handoff, and P0 draft isolation; bridge and disclosure boundaries are strong, while draft identity and transition semantics remain a critical gap.
